rca of the issue: Original bug: edge agent registered with empty enrollment_token, so agent never received a signing_secret usable for HMAC heartbeats, keeping real_online=false and /diagnostics stuck on 'not connected'. Fix (client-side agent.py): prompts operator for pairing code on first run, sends it on /register, re-prompts on 401, persists identity, self-registers Windows auto-start. Backend register/heartbeat unchanged and validated green.
